name: Keeping You Close
source:
They were your closest friend. 

They loved you, they really did.

They loved you to the point of hurting the people you cared about, to keep you for themselves.

So, you locked them in a rusted dog cage in your basement.

It was the only way.

[From [url=https://aiainaine.itch.io/keeping-you-close]itch.io[/url]]
